name: BSP_RewardsScreen_Construct
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall(this) returning this, SEH frame, RET. The 260h screen at 00E198AC+60h. Chains BSP_FrontEndScreen_Construct (004F7180), installs primary vtable 00CF50CC at +00h and 00CF50B8 at +08h, 00CF5098 at +0Ch, zeroes several field runs and calls 00683610 three times. Slot +00h of 00CF50CC is 00626710, a 'mov eax,4; ret' leaf, so the screen id is 4 = INTF_REWARDS, which matches the id 00686380 commits when DAT_00E198B0 is 1. Register override 00629D10 binds FE_scoring and names its six pages FE.scoring_single_page1, FE.scoring_multi_page1, FE.scoring_objectives, FE.scoring_detailed_score, FE.scoring_rank and FE.scoring_awards. See docs/MAIN_MENU_SCREENS.md.

evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. __fastcall void(MissionRecord* record), ECX only, RET. Copies record+08h (the Lua name) into the string at 00E19798 (0062694D/00626968) and record+38h (debriefingText) into the string at 00E197A0 (00626985/006269A1), then clears twelve containers at 00E196CC, 00E196DC, 00E196EC (004954F0), 00E196FC, 00E19710, 00E19724 (005F6190), 00E19738, 00E19748, 00E19758 (006226F0), 00E19768, 00E19778, 00E19788 (004954F0).
